verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents its own SDKs: Swift and Kotlin, a React Native SDK that gives JavaScript developers an official library, and a C++ core with "six thin bindings." No Python library is evidenced, and the OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint relies on OpenAI's clients rather than RunAnywhere's, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an evidenced official Python library, a plain JavaScript/Node (non-React-Native) client, a documented list of all six bindings, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript
